collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/s81dv_idxtxn32b --out {RUN}/record/views/dsdv_idx_tx_n32 --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_1024x256_m2_r2c2 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run
